title: 1132 Fixer support report, contract version 1
description: Body of POST /v1/feedback. Every 1132 Fixer product sends this same shape.

requestId.description: Client-made UUID. A retry of the same content sends the same value. It must equal the Idempotency-Key header when both are sent.

text.description: The words of the person who sends the report. At least one visible character. 102400 bytes or fewer as UTF-8: x-maxUtf8Bytes is not standard JSON Schema; the checker in validate.js applies it.

product.description: The 1132 Fixer product that sends the report. The order of this list has no meaning.

version.description: Version of the product that sends the report.

os.description: Operating system or browser name and version.

rating.description: Required with type User Rating. Not permitted with any other type.

data.description: Base64 image bytes. The decoded image is 5 MiB or smaller.

diagnostics.description: Technical report that the product made. Sent only when the person agreed to send it; see consent.

text.description: At least one visible character. 65536 bytes or fewer as UTF-8 (x-maxUtf8Bytes, applied by validate.js).

consent.description: What the person agreed to send in this one report.

diagnostics.description: True only when the person chose to attach the diagnostics to this report.
